name: Westphal field 2 (Hubble)
blurb: Westphal field 2, a deep field toward distant Lyman break galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: westphalfield2-hubble
story: Among the faint smudges in this patch of sky are distant star-forming galaxies. Deep ground-based spectra hinted that some of them leak Lyman-continuum light, and Hubble came to take a sharper look.

claims.text: WESTPHAL-2-IR is a pointing of Hubble program 15287 aimed at high-redshift galaxies
The program targets Lyman break galaxies in five fields, including Westphal
Keck spectra showed apparent Lyman-continuum detections in some of these star-forming galaxies
The program's purpose is Lyman-continuum studies
